model.name: folder.dropPlacesLinkRemoveDelete
model.description: Every folder is a drop target via the one contract; a drop of any oop object places a LINK to the one stored unit (never a copy); REMOVE unlinks here (unit+other links survive); DELETE (red, confirm) removes the unit from the index + all links (zero dangling). Registered per class (no central switch).
model.note: class/method=null - architect wires on build-go (per-class drop/link/remove/delete registration over R37.20) + resolves LINK-vs-MOVE composition.
